data.body: Interim blast-radius update: receive-pack is not globally broken. From a fresh worktree at current origin/main (665d1d0480187) I created empty scratch commit fa547db55644 and normal upload `git push gerrit HEAD:refs/for/main` succeeded, creating Gerrit change 2813; I abandoned it immediately. Recent successful rebar changes were also created at 2026-09-08 01:24, 01:30, 01:32, and the scratch at 02:03 UTC. Current evidence points to pushes referencing specific missing server object(s)/history around older base 710a606b and trees 1959f268/1af810df, not all review uploads.
